changes.after: Non-custodial crypto staking, smart contract audits, and blockchain consulting, all powered by our own self-hosted infrastructure. Trusted by institutions, developers, and crypto holders worldwide.

changes.before: Attestant is a curated node operator and the team behind both Dirk (distributed key manager) and Vouch (multi-node Ethereum consensus client). We focus on secure, professional validator operations and have built a lot of the open-source tooling that underpins best-practice staking infrastructure.
